heading: **10 November 2025**
body:
***SELEX checklist***

| Requirement | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| lig147 plate (1x) | To be aliquoted  |
| ligN40w107 plate (1x) | To be aliquoted  |
| PCR Mix Plate (non-PE PCR) (16 plates) \+ DilutionPCR plates (16 plates) | To be aliquoted  |
| qPCR Mix Plate (12x) | To be aliquoted  |
| Forward Primer Plate 5 uM (PE PCR)  | **Prepared** |
| Reverse Primer Plate 5 uM (PE PCR) | **PE0-PE3 prepared\*** |
| Dilution Buffer Plate (for reconstitution) (10X) | **Prepared** |
| Biotin Elution Buffer Plate | To be aliquoted |
| SBP Beads Plate | To be prepared |
| Ni Beads Plate | To be prepared |
| Diluted TF Plate | Prepared 2 days prior to assay |
| Buffers | **Prepared** |
| Dried Salt Plates (10X) | **Prepared** |
| SBP Histone Octamer Plate | To be aliquoted |
| Beckman Programs | Programs Added Pipetting template to be tested |

***lig147 plate:***

Volume per well \= 20 uL  
Concentration required \= 25 ng/uL  
Wells \= 400

Total DNA (ug) \= 200 ug  
Total Volume \= 8 mL

Take 4878 uL of lig147 PCR2 product \+ 3122 uL TE buffer

Split into a single NUNC plate with 20 uL per well.

***ligN40w107 plate:***

Volume per well \= 20 uL  
Concentration required \= 25 ng/uL  
Wells \= 400

Total DNA (ug) \= 200 ug  
Total Volume \= 8 mL

⇒ The samples for ligN40w107 are first being pooled and concentrated to obtain sufficient amounts of DNA for aliquoting.

***SBP Histone Octamer Plate:***

Octamer concentration \= 7.25 ug/uL \= 7250 ng/uL

Prepare 35 ng/uL octamer with 20 uL per well ⇒ 12 X 400 X 35 \= 168 ug SBP-octamer

Take 23.2 uL of original octamer and make up solution to 4800 uL (add 4776.8 uL of refolding buffer:glycerol (1:1))

Add 666 uL per well of a 96-well storage plate. From here use the Beckman robot to first add 83 uL per well of same 96-well plate & then finally aliquot this to 20 uL per well in a single 4ti384-well plate.

***Protein Plates:***

Take proteins from DBD QD1, QD2, QD3 ⇒ **288 proteins**

Commercial proteins ⇒  MAX, MYC:MAX, New TETR, P53, YY1 ⇒ **4 proteins**

Baker lab proteins ⇒ **8 proteins**

ELF proteins ⇒ ELF2m2, ELF2m3, ELF2m23, ELF2mALL ⇒ **4 proteins**

Remaining 78 proteins to be taken from FL Q3, Q4 (large-scale expression). Leave two wells empty as control (fill these with just TF dilution buffer).

For all proteins in plates as well as Baker lab proteins and ELF proteins & MAX ⇒ Take 15 uL proteins \+ 45 uL TF dilution buffer \[**For 5 rounds of NCAP-SELEX, HT-SELEX i.e. one ligand lig147**\]

DBD QD1 ⇒ Quadrant 1 of TF plate  
DBD QD2 ⇒ Quadrant 2 of TF plate  
DBD QD3 ⇒ Quadrant 3 of TF plate  
Baker lab prot, Commercial, ELF, FL Q3/Q4 ⇒ Quadrant 4 of TF plate

For all commercial proteins, I need to take 1.5 ug of protein in a well and then make up volume to 60 uL so that there is no dead volume.

MAX 30  
c\~MYC:MAX 7.5  
CTCF 15  
TETR 3.5  
YY1 25  
ELFM2  
ELF2m3  
ELF2m23  
ELF2mALL  
DLX2  
Q3 FL A1-B2

***Dilution Buffer Plate:***

80 uL of buffer to be added per plate \= Total about 320 mL of buffer needed 

***SBP Beads Plate:***

2.5 mL of original beads → remove storage buffer and then resuspend the beads in 55 mL of salt-free blocking buffer. Incubate on rotator for 30 minutes.

*Testing*  
Take 10.1 uL original beads and separate the storage buffer and resuspend in 458.3 uL of salt-free blocking buffer. Test splitting of these beads into 16 wells of a 384-well plate to test if the beads are split evenly.

Using this testing paradigm the SBPBeadsTest program worked with 104 uL of beads per well and then aliquot with slow pipetting 25 uL per quadrant of a 384-well plate
title: SELEX checklist
